Replace the entire astronaut figure, including helmet, spacesuit and life-support pack, with the reference Shiba superhero viewed from behind on the reflective platform; preserve the running steps, final arm spread, asteroid field, directional light and moving reflection.

Use the rear-view Shiba superhero in the airborne arms-out pose on the sunset vehicle roof as the key appearance; apply the identical character to the opening moonlit bridge segment and preserve the exact bridge-to-street transition, jump continuity, landing and camera framing.

Replace the robed woman with the reference Shiba superhero in the close three-quarter high-knee dance pose, clearly establishing its canine face, chest insignia, armor and raised boot; preserve the wide-to-close camera progression, subsequent wider composition, reflective platform, mountain lake and transition into enormous surrounding waves.

shots.note: The foreground lead walks toward the camera through a dark backstage passage with a microphone held low; the sampled ending briefly shows the alternate robed female lead in the same passage, who must also become the same Shiba superhero. Keep background people and the camera operator unchanged.

The black-clad lead approaches in frontal and three-quarter views, then lifts the microphone arm above the head while the other arm stays lower; preserve hand contact with the microphone and the nearby camera crew.

The robed lead appears from the front and slightly to the side, bows the head and raises a microphone overhead while stepping toward the sunlit stage edge; replace the entire lead silhouette with the reference armored body.

The foreground horned armored performer holds a microphone above the head and dips forward in a front three-quarter view; replace the helmet and all original armor, while leaving distant stage personnel and background figures unchanged.

The robed lead continues the overhead microphone gesture near the stage edge, then bends the elbow and lowers the arm while looking down; the crowd and wedge monitors remain in their original positions.

The lead lowers the microphone toward the waist and turns into a right-facing side profile toward the daylight audience; preserve the forward movement and microphone grip with the reference armored glove.

The long-haired lead moves in side profile along a nighttime stage, holding a microphone near the torso before lowering the hand; replace the visible head and body while preserving the audience phone lights and camera tracking.

The traveler dances on a moving train roof, turning from side profile to rear view with alternating raised knees; retain the tan backpack and red scarf over the replacement armor and keep the handheld prop in the corresponding gloved hand.

The bucket-hatted lead is viewed from behind on a concert runway, leaning forward and alternating raised legs while holding a microphone low; replace the hat, streetwear and shoes with the reference canine head and complete armored outfit.

The robed lead dances away from the camera along a narrow grass platform beside the lake, bending forward and lifting a leg with a microphone held low; replace the flowing costume with the reference back armor and boots while retaining the step timing.

The horned armored lead is seen from behind, centered on the nighttime runway, performing alternating knee lifts and bringing both hands toward the hips; show the reference back emblem and preserve the strong light behind the head.

The ninja moves along a broad tree trunk, initially seen from behind and then turning side-on with a raised knee and bent arms; replace the human head, ponytail, clothing and footwear while retaining the sword and its relationship to the body.

The traveler continues dancing on the train roof, lifting a knee in side view, rotating to show the backpack and moving away; retain the scarf, backpack, handheld prop, foot placement and train motion.

The astronaut is viewed from behind running and skipping along a reflective platform in an asteroid field, then spreading both arms; replace the complete astronaut silhouette with the Shiba superhero and update its reflection and shadow.

The opening shows a distant dark-clad lead with arms spread on a moonlit wooden bridge, then transitions to a rear-view streetwear lead jumping and landing on a moving vehicle roof at sunset; replace both lead appearances with the same Shiba superhero and preserve the internal transition exactly.

The robed lead dances on a transparent reflective platform, progressing from a wide full-body view to a close raised-knee pose and back to a wider view as the mountain lake transforms into towering waves; replace the entire performer with the armored Shiba superhero, preserving choreography, platform contact, camera motion and synchronized reflection.
